articles.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
articles.snippet: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin crashes to 3-month low below $63,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
articles.snippet: "They are now selling at the very price they wish they had taken advantage of three months ago," wrote James Check.

articles.title: UK, Singapore, and Thailand central banks test cross-border FX settlement as stablecoins gain ground
articles.snippet: Project Meridian FX APAC said it demonstrated how transactions can be coordinated across conventional settlement systems and those built using blockchain technology.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips below $70,000 as Dollar Index hits 19-month high
articles.snippet: The crypto market selloff gathered pace early Friday. Bitcoin dropped below $70,000 and ether traded below $2,000, triggering large liquidations in futures market.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls to four-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
articles.snippet: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.
